adjudication.rationale: The diff adds substantial new behavior (Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed uses SimpleRSS.parse(open(...)); TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve/#fetch_http calls PollFeed and TopicEmbed.import_remote(open(url).read); TopicEmbed.import_remote uses ruby-readability). The added specs largely test only gating/dispatch: poll_feed_spec asserts poll_feed is/ isn’t called but never exercises parsing/open/import; topic_retriever_spec stubs retrieved_recently? and only asserts perform_retrieve is invoked/avoided (and in other cases expects perform_retrieve never), so perform_retrieve/fetch_http behavior isn’t exercised. topic_embed_spec covers .import (including relative-URL absolutization) but not .import_remote’s HTTP/readability path. This is a concrete, diff-grounded test coverage gap rather than a functional defect.
